firm_data.firm_description: Leader Berkon Colao & Silverstein LLP represents a wide array of clients, including Fortune 500 companies, small businesses, and individuals, in civil litigation, and complex business disputes. They offer exceptional, economical and innovative representation in challenging legal matters.
notable_facts: Offices in New York, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, Dallas, and San Francisco

email.subject: AI for Leader Berkon Colao & Silverstein LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Your firm handles some of the most complex business disputes in the country, representing Fortune 500 companies across five major markets. That kind of challenging litigation demands both precision and efficiency, especially when competing for client attention.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
